headline: Xətai district features 3 metro stations and 95% paved roads.

summary: Xətai supports a population of 277,800 across 34.5 km², yielding a density of 9,260 residents per km². Transport is served by 3 metro stations, 4 rail stations, and 36 bus routes with 162 bus stops. The local market records 16,203 listings with a 73% title extract share («çıxarış») and a 34% mortgage share. Paved roads account for 95% of known surfaces, surpassing the median of 83.1%. Price samples indicate new build apartments at AZN 2,354/m² and old build apartments at AZN 1,973/m².
